versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Local Business Finder.
- Search for any local business on Google Maps by category and location.
- Retrieve business names, phone numbers, emails, websites, ratings, and hours.
- Supports filters (e.g., minimum rating, must have website) and prompts for confirmation before searches.
- Each search uses 2 credits; free accounts get 5 searches.
- Outputs results in a clean, scannable format and offers next steps like cold emails or competitor analysis.
